comparison.objective: Exchange two internal enclosure modules and close the enclosure; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced obstruction removal, rail withdrawal, replacement insertion, and lid closeout versus two-tool adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct replacements seated, removed parts collected, enclosure retained versus locked 90° opening and cycle retention.
comparison.reason: The enclosure service sequence does not test coupled stop-screw and jam-nut control.
